I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I said I'd noted that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats, and that I hadn't changed anything else.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't touch his #central-team post. I mentioned that if he wants it corrected there, he'll need to edit it himself. A seat count is an account detail, not a money figure, so repeating it in the channel doesn't need anyone's approval.
